CONCEPT PROJECT / EDITORIAL · VISUAL STORYTELLING

Slow Good↗

An independent editorial concept celebrating the beauty hiding in ordinary moments.

ROLE
Editorial · Visual storytelling
TIMELINE
4-week concept
STATUS
Concept / 2026
TOOLS
InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop
01 / THE CHALLENGE

How do you make a slow-reading experience feel fresh, generous, and worth keeping?

The approach

An oversized editorial grid combines playful illustration with intimate passages and intentional pauses. Each spread has its own pace.

The intended outcome

A sample issue, cover family, and digital reading direction. Reader feedback would shape the final type sizes, pacing, and issue structure.

Illustrative concept. No real client, launch, or measured results are claimed.
EXPLORE THE DETAILS
01 / 03
02 / BEHIND THE IDEA

From a question
to a point of view.

01 — RESEARCH

Find the right question.

Studied the rhythm of independent magazines and mapped moments when a reader might pause, return, or share a page.

02 — SKETCH & EXPLORE

Follow a few loose threads.

Built paper dummies to test sequencing, page turns, and contrast between dense stories and visual breathing room.

03 — DESIGN & REFINE

Make the idea tangible.

A bold cover opens into quieter pages. A recurring blue motif connects the print object to its digital companion.

04 / WHAT I’M TAKING FORWARD

Little details.
Lasting lessons.

Whitespace is part of the story. Letting each spread breathe made the small details feel more important.
